question: Question
defaultDirections: Select the answer you feel answers the question. When you are done, press {checkAnswer}. You will get feedback indicating correctness of your answer and how to proceed.
relatedContentDescription: This creates a collapsed area for content related to this question and is always shown
hintDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer wrong
evidenceDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer correct
numericDirections: Type a number. The unit is shown for you. When you are done, select {checkAnswer}.
withinPercent: Answers within {tolerance}% of the exact value count.
withinAbsolute: Answers within {tolerance} of the exact value count.
notSetUp: This question has no answer set up yet.
formulaHelp: A number, or a formula that uses the variables below, for example d / (t / 60). Formulas can use + - * / ^, parentheses, sqrt() and abs().
tokensHelp: Show a variable in the question by writing its name in braces, for example {d}.
keyProblem: This can not be worked out yet. Check that every name in the formula is a variable.
